fields.heading: Your listing has been cancelled
fields.body:
Hello {first_name},

Trading of {pitch_title} on the marketplace has been suspended. We have therefore had to withdraw your see listing from the marketplace.

Please view the investment within your investment holdings for the latest updates on this investment.
